ogTitle: Free Online Developer Tools – Base64, JSON, UUID & More
ogDescription: Base64, JSON and YAML formatters, UUID generator, URL and HTML encoders and Docker compose converters. Free, private, in-browser.

faq.a: A small collection of browser-based developer tools: Base64 encode/decode, URL and HTML escaping, JSON and YAML formatting, JSON/YAML conversion, UUID generation, Docker compose conversion and a bookmark-bar organizer. No installs, no accounts — open a page and use it.

faq.q: Is my data private when I use these tools?
faq.a: Yes — every tool runs client-side. Your input is processed by JavaScript in your own browser and never sent to a server, which is kind of the point of the site.

faq.q: Do I need to create an account or pay?
faq.a: No account, no payment, no usage caps. Open the tool, paste your input, copy the result.

faq.q: Do the tools work on mobile devices?
faq.a: They're responsive and run in any modern browser, so phone, tablet or laptop all behave the same.

faq.q: Which is the most popular tool on Unitoolify?
faq.a: The Base64 encoder , the Base64 decoder and the JSON formatter get the most traffic, with the UUID generator and the Docker compose converter not far behind.
